requiredHistory.purpose: Confirm the chronic CHF and COPD baseline before coding the acute-on-chronic and exacerbation codes.

grading.notes: Required codes are the gold set. Forbidden codes are hard errors. E/M codes matching ^99[2-4] are ignored because E/M assignment is out of scope.

notes: Tests acute-on-chronic specificity, COPD exacerbation, a two-view chest X-ray, and nebulized bronchodilator treatment.
